title: Cardinality of a sign-cube face
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $i$ be a coordinate with $0\\le i<n$. Among the sign vectors in $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, the vectors whose $i$th coordinate is $1$ form a set of cardinality $2^{n-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate $i$ in the range $0\\le i<n$
